arguments_redacted.content: The date formatting helper `iso_date` produces ambiguous output because it uses the month before the day in the format string. This can lead to confusion, especially when the month and day are close in value. For example, `iso_date(2023, 12, 25)` will output `12/25/2023`, which could be interpreted as December 25 or February 25 depending on the context. To fix this, the format string should be changed to `f'{year}-{month}-{day}'` to ensure clarity and consistency.
